metadata.title: Emilio Blacksmith Herrera
metadata.description: Emilio Herrera, aka BLACKSMITH. Product engineer across modern frontends, high-performance backends, and cloud infrastructure — recommendation systems, LLM agentic workflows, and edge deployments, shipped from scratch.

hero.bio: Product Engineer forging full-scale software end-to-end — interfaces, serverless backends, and AI features built on LLM workflows and agentic systems. Currently building at Finsphera and founding Blacksmith Softworks from Puebla, Mexico.
hero.helloCard: Hello! I'm Emilio — the Blacksmith. Product Engineer & indie app developer based in <mexico>Mexico</mexico>, currently building AI-driven features <finsphera>@ Finsphera</finsphera>.
